messages:
maria-sec: Heads up: after the KMS rewrap at 02:15 UTC we're seeing SCIM provisioning JWE decrypt errors from several customers. Lots of 'decrypt failed: no matching key' and 'unsupported alg' in logs.

 devops-bot: alert: 38 failed SCIM attempts since 02:17 UTC - https://grafana.company/alerts/abcd :rotating_light:

 raj-iam: digging in. Sample log: ```{"jwe_header":{"alg":"RSA-OAEP","enc":"A256GCM","kid":"projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/key/cryptoKeyVersions/3"}, "err":"decrypt failed"}```

 sam-platform: we upgraded the default to OAEP-256 when rewrapping, but some IdPs still send RSA-OAEP. that mismatch will cause decrypt to fail if we strictly enforce alg.

 olivia-sre: short term fix: accept both RSA-OAEP and RSA-OAEP-256 in the proxy decryptor and attempt both. add header logs so we can map IdP behavior.

 raj-iam: applying hotfix to staging: proxy will try kid match + alg match, else fallback to alternate alg path, with verbose header logging. running integration tests now.

 devops-bot: deploy: svc-idp-proxy v1.4.5-hotfix -> canary 5%

 maria-sec: critical: when decrypt fails the RBAC audit emitter drops deprovision events. create INCIDENT-2026, assign owners for audit-gap, KMS playbook, and postmortem.

 sam-platform: opening TASK-438: update rotation playbook, add compatibility gate (verify alg variants), and add unit tests for rewrap job.

 olivia-sre: monitoring updated: scim_decrypt_failures_by_alg + rbac_audit_missing_count. will escalate if canary > 1% failure.

 raj-iam: canary looks good after 10m. promoting to 100% in 10m unless alerts.

 maria-sec: thanks. postmortem template: include timeline, impacted orgs, detection, mitigation, and action items (compatibility checks + automated smoke post-rotate).
